name: Desert Fennec Mage
description: An original fennec mage from CRO-MAGNON, with upright ears, a fluffy tail, primitive hide and fur clothing, and bare paws. Created from an original concept image using local TRELLIS-2 reconstruction. The default animation casts a spell in 0.8 seconds and releases it after 0.4 seconds, matching the game. The spell leaves the hands, with a trail that grows along its flight. The 1.6-second display loop includes the spell flight and return to idle. Nine additional game animations are included. Cover photographed from this model in a right-facing pose.
